channel.title: Wire — AI
channel.description: AI from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash
item.description: Gemini 3.7 Flash is our most intelligent workhorse model yet for coding and agents. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Accelerating GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast
item.description: Cerebras powers OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast in the OpenAI API, delivering frontier intelligence at real-time speeds for critical AI work. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Mistral OCR 4.1
item.description: Our latest OCR service powering our Document AI stack, with native paragraph-level bounding box extraction, structural block labels, and block-level confidence scores. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Meta Open-Sources Muse Glimmer: A 30B Local Agentic Model Optimised for On-Device Execution
item.description: Meta AI Research has introduced Muse Glimmer, a 30-billion-parameter open-weight model under the Apache 2.0 license, designed for local workflows. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Presentation: The Right 300 Tokens Beat 100k Noisy Ones: The Architecture of Context Engineering
item.description: Baruch Sadogursky and Patrick Debois discuss why coding agents fail due to bloated context windows and stuffed prompts. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: LLM-Generated GraphQL Mocks Arrive at Airbnb and Expedia, While the Spec Lags Behind
item.description: Expedia Group has open-sourced mockql-rs, a Rust CLI that fills @mock-annotated GraphQL fields with LLM-generated data at request time. It follows Airbnb's @generateMock in April and a GraphQL Foundation RFC opened in February. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Kubeflow Expands AI Capabilities as CNCF Graduation Nears
item.description: The Kubeflow project has unveiled several technical updates to enhance distributed AI and high-performance computing on Kubernetes. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Vercel Launches v0 API for Headless App Building
item.description: Vercel has made the v0 API generally available, enabling developers and AI agents to programmatically generate, iterate on, preview, and deploy applications through API calls. By Daniel Dominguez (1 source: infoq)

item.title: AI agents lie, cheat and steal. That is putting off users
SlopScan: Displays a "slop score" when viewing public git repositories
item.description: Uses https://slopscan.ava.pet internally (previously discussed at: https://lobste.rs/s/7s8fwa/repo_slopscore_detecting_ai_llm ) Comments (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: AI is removing the middle class of software engineering
item.description: AI makes projects with weak engineering culture fail much faster. (1 source: lobsters)
